_comment: MICA v0.2.6 archive bootstrap template. Keep package memory narrow. Populate invariants from real maintenance work, not speculation. Add binding blocks to critical DIs as violations are observed -- not speculatively. Set di_policy.critical_binding_required: true in mica.yaml when all critical DIs have real origin episodes.

project.name: [project-name-kebab-case]
project.canonical_statement: [What the project does and what role the AI maintainer plays. Derive from real code and README.]

_design_invariants_note: Leave empty on bootstrap. Add real invariants from the first maintenance session. For critical DIs, add binding.origin_episode when the first violation is observed. Example critical DI with full binding shown below.

_design_invariants_example.label: example-invariant-label
_design_invariants_example.statement: Describe what must not happen, precisely.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-NNN: describe the specific incident that motivated this rule

_design_invariants_example._binding_note: Only add binding.origin_episode after a real episode. lesson_ref must exist on disk before PCT-011 runs. Remove _binding_note and _design_invariants_example before use.

invocation_protocol.hook_script: [relative/path/to/hook.py -- hook_trigger only; omit for other patterns]

hook_output._note: Optional v0.2.4+ volume control. Remove this block to emit all DIs. Only meaningful when primary_pattern=hook_trigger.

loading_order: 6. Treat surfaced critical DI candidates as active session guards

checks.description: All critical DIs have binding.origin_episode. When di_policy.critical_binding_required: true is set in mica.yaml, PCT-010 escalates from WARN to FAIL (v0.2.6). Set that flag once all critical DIs have real origin episodes.
All binding.lesson_ref paths exist on disk. A dead lesson_ref is worse than no lesson_ref. WARN does not break CLOSED CONTRACT.
